resources.string: This app continues as Nuvio RS, which installs next to the official Nuvio. Install Nuvio RS to keep getting updates. Your settings move over automatically.
Nuvio RS is installed. Open it to move your settings, then uninstall this old app.
Could not download Nuvio RS. Try again later.
Allow installs from this app, then tap Install Nuvio RS again.
Your settings were moved from the old Nuvio app, which you can now uninstall. MDBList and Simkl need to be connected again.
To move your settings, open the old Nuvio app and install its latest update, then come back.
Your settings from the old Nuvio app are ready. Nuvio RS will restart to apply them, replacing its current settings.
